title: Machine learning-based integrated identification of predictive combined diagnostic biomarkers for endometriosis
summary: Transcriptomic machine-learning analyses nominated five genes as candidate endometriosis diagnostic biomarkers. A five-gene model reached AUC 0.836 in a test dataset, with checks on additional public datasets. This is dataset-level biomarker evidence rather than a demonstrated clinical diagnostic intervention.
ai_technology: Methods apply multiple learned feature-selection and classification algorithms to transcriptomic data to identify endometriosis-associated diagnostic genes.
organization: Southern Medical University; Shenzhen People’s Hospital

source_review.scope: Primary full text, including Methods and Results; primary publication record or first result-bearing version checked.

evidence.tested: Eleven algorithms were evaluated; candidate genes FOS, EPHX1, DLGAP5, PCSK5 and ADAT1 were assessed using dataset checks.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective public expression datasets; clinical diagnostic utility was not demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: Methods apply multiple learned feature-selection and classification algorithms to transcriptomic data to identify endometriosis-associated diagnostic genes.
